candidates.explanation: After verifying the hash and updating the user's password, the method never invalidates existing sessions. It should call the session service's deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) after the password update. Without that, refresh tokens tied to existing sessions on other devices (e.g. the phone) remain valid and can still be used to renew login.

fix.description: After `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);` in resetPassword, add `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` (inject SessionService if not already injected) so all sessions/refresh tokens are revoked on password reset.
